summary.text: Yin Yang Great Killer Hands is a qi path killer move that forms two huge black and white hands to seize and tear a target.

claims.text: In immemorial white heaven’s qi path battlefield, after Duke Long’s reverse worm dragon currents fuse into one divine dragon, Fang Yuan activates the qi path killer move Yin-yang Great Killer Hands. With a loud explosion, two huge hands, one black and one white, appear out of nowhere. The hands loom over heaven and earth, grab the qi dragon’s neck and tail, hold firm while the dragon struggles, and when Fang Yuan pulls from afar the dragon snaps in two.

When Spectral Soul Demon Venerable presses Qing Chou and Heavenly Court, Qi Sea Ancestor activates immortal killer move Yin-yang Great Killer Hands and the same black and white giant hands grab toward Spectral Soul. Spectral Soul vanishes and reappears in front of Qi Sea Ancestor, leaving an immemorial soul beast where he had been.

Fang Yuan’s qi path clone arrives and slams the two giant hands at Spectral Soul again; Spectral Soul answers with black smoke that releases two immemorial soul beasts into the hands. The hands grab and pain the beasts without killing them at once, and Qi Sea Ancestor must keep the hands up to hold them, spending mental energy, immortal essence, and timing while Spectral Soul keeps absorbing Qing Chou. Fang Yuan judges that Yin-yang Great Killer Hands is Qi Sea clone’s most common offensive method, with heavenly astral cloth robe as the main defense, and that the clone’s thin method set lets Spectral Soul form counters after a few exchanges.

When Fairy Yu Xiu fights Qi Sea Ancestor, she is familiar with his methods; yin-yang great killer hands, heavenly astral cloth robe, unlimited qi sea, and others have been used many times and are known to everyone.
